correctness.rationale: A primitive 30-square alternating orientation cycle, connected closed surface with circular links, and exact cellular incidence prove genus six and A5 orientation preservation. Trace of the 1-dimensional graph chain action gives H1 traces (-2,0,1) for even nontrivial class types and hence Lefschetz fixed-point counts (6,2,0). Finite-order orientation-preserving surface fixed points have index +1; stabilizers cyclic; 15 involutions and 20 order-3 elements yield exactly three order-2 branch orbits and one order-3 orbit; exact Riemann–Hurwitz yields genus zero. Full 240-action checker and exact branch calculation replayed from current package path.

value.rationale: The complete branching/orbifold signature of the canonical genus-six icosahedral surface action is an intrinsic equivariant-topology invariant not supplied by genus and Betti numbers. It explicitly classifies the quotient's topology and four ramification strata, of use to studying surface coverings and group actions; it is a natural whole-quotient classification, not an arbitrary narrow numerical slice.
